description: This file appears to be a C header file defining private interface functions for a LAN manager wrapper module, including function prototypes for stopping scans, fetching LAN host comments, setting LAN host comments, and retrieving Ethernet port information.

methods.name: lm_wrapper_priv_stop_scan
methods.description: Function to stop a LAN scan process.

methods.name: lm_wrapper_priv_getLanHostComments
methods.description: Function to retrieve comments for a LAN host given a physical address.

methods.name: lm_wrapper_priv_set_lan_host_comments
methods.description: Function to set comments for a LAN host using a command structure.

methods.name: lm_wrapper_priv_getEthernetPort
methods.description: Function to get Ethernet port information associated with a MAC address.
